title: dedoomify: AI news, minus the doom
excerpt: Read AI news without the doom. “Is misaligned” becomes “has a bug”.
content_html:
What if AI failures were described like ordinary software issues? Paste a link to any AI story and we'll turn down the apocalypse: the model is misaligned becomes the model has a bug.

Less Skynet. More software. And every change is highlighted with the original text one hover or tap away. Runs on quick phrase rules or a local AI model in your browser via WebGPU!

Open Source on GitHub · Privacy · Send feedback · X
